description:
From quick weekend rides to multi-day bikepacking trips. Carbon fiber dampens ground vibrations while ensuring frame stiffness where it matters most, allowing you to push hard on the pedals without losing energy. Every rough stretch of gravel is smoothed out, leaving you free to ride for hours without fatigue. The perfect partner for riders looking to push past their limits, blending carbon’s lightweight performance with rugged durability at a competitive price point. No fluff—just you and whatever path you take.Advanced carbon construction mutes trail chatter while delivering targeted stiffness to maximize power transfer. By smoothing out rough gravel, it keeps you fresh for long hours in the saddle. The perfect partner for riders stepping beyond their limits—blending carbon’s lightweight performance with rugged durability at a competitive price point. No fluff, just you and whatever path you take.

Color is more than just looks; it’s the landscape you choose to get lost in. Caedanha’s matte finishes become one with the natural world around you.

If our curated combinations aren’t enough, start with a blank canvas. From colour selection to finishes (matte, gloss or mixed), right down to the finest graphic details, we’ll create a Carrera that’s uniquely yours.

From S to XXL, Caedhana’s monocoque frame is calibrated to offer every rider the same balance between aerodynamics and drive. If you already know your biomechanical measurements, use the Stack and Reach values as a reference to identify your size.
